meta.title: VoiceCart | Your shop's website, just by speaking
meta.description: Describe your shop out loud in Hindi or English. VoiceCart turns it into a professional website your customers can browse and order from on WhatsApp.

hero.title: Your shop, online. Just by speaking.
hero.body: Describe your shop out loud in Hindi or English. VoiceCart turns it into a professional website your customers can browse and order from on WhatsApp.
hero.note: No coding. No designer. You check everything before it goes live.

how.title: From your voice to your website in three steps

speak.title: Speak
speak.body: Tap the microphone and talk about your shop: what you sell, your prices and when you're open. Prefer typing? That works too.

review.title: Review
review.body: VoiceCart fills in your shop's details and asks about anything missing. You correct what you like. Nothing is saved until you confirm.

publish.title: Publish
publish.body: Pick a design, add your photos and go live. Share your link or QR code with customers on WhatsApp.

features.title: Everything a local shop needs to look professional
features.body: Built around how shops in India really sell, from price ranges to WhatsApp orders.

voice.title: Set up by voice
voice.body: Speak in Hindi or English. VoiceCart picks out your products, prices, hours and contact details.
voice.sample: Pastries are 60 rupees in chocolate and vanilla

order.title: Orders straight to WhatsApp
order.body: Customers fill an order list and send it in one clear message, with every item, size and price.

variety.title: Real prices, real variety
variety.body: Sizes, flavours, colours, price ranges and “starting at” prices.

open.title: Always-right hours
open.body: An Open now label worked out from your hours, even with an afternoon break.

review.title: Nothing made up
review.body: The AI can only use what you said, and you confirm every detail before anything is published.

photos.title: Your photos
photos.body: Upload from your phone, with separate photos for each colour or size.

search.title: Easy to browse
search.body: Customers can search and jump between your categories.

share.title: Link and QR code
share.body: A clean web address and a QR code to print for your counter.

editor.title: Update any time
editor.body: Change prices, mark items sold out, or edit your hours in seconds.

designs.title: 25 designs, chosen for your kind of shop
designs.body: Five for each shop type, from online-shop grids to printed-style menus. Switch whenever you like.

skills.q: Do I need any technical skills?
skills.a: No. If you can describe your shop on the phone, you can use VoiceCart. There's no coding, and no design work.

languages.a: You can speak or type in Hindi or English, and use the app and your website in either language.

invent.q: Could the AI get my details wrong?
invent.a: Voice recognition can make mistakes, so you see the words first and can correct them. VoiceCart only uses what you said, and nothing is saved until you check it.

voice.a: No. Your audio is sent to our speech provider to turn it into text and isn't stored by VoiceCart. Our privacy policy explains the details.

orders.a: Customers send their order to you on WhatsApp, and you agree payment and delivery with them directly, the way you do today. VoiceCart doesn't take online payments yet.

edit.q: Can I change things after publishing?
edit.a: Yes. You can update products, prices, photos, hours and your design at any time, or take your shop offline.

final.title: Your customers are already looking for you.
final.body: Give them somewhere to find your shop, see your products and reach you.

privacy.title: Privacy Policy
privacy.intro: VoiceCart helps shop owners create a website by describing their shop. This policy explains what we collect, why we collect it and the choices you have. We've written it in plain language.
privacy.contactBody: For any privacy question, or to correct or delete your information, contact us at:

sections.title: What we collect from shop owners
points: Account details: your name, email address and profile picture from Google when you sign in.
Shop details: your shop's name, category, description, phone and WhatsApp numbers, address and opening hours.
Products: names, descriptions, prices, options and the photos, logo and banner you upload.
Voice setup: the text of your spoken or typed answers.
Usage records: how many AI requests your account makes, so we can apply daily limits and manage cost.

sections.title: Your voice recordings
sections.body: When you use the microphone, your audio goes to our speech provider to be turned into text. VoiceCart does not store the audio. We do keep the text of your answers so you can review them and continue your setup later. Please don't share anyone else's personal details while recording.

sections.title: What we collect from customers
sections.body: Customers can browse a shop without an account, and we don't ask them for personal details. An order list stays in the customer's own browser until they clear it. When a customer sends an order, it goes through WhatsApp directly to the shop, so VoiceCart doesn't receive it. We keep a small cookie to remember the chosen language. Each shop is responsible for how it handles the orders and messages it receives.

sections.title: How we use information
points: To create, show and update your shop's website.
To sign you in and keep your account secure.
To turn your voice into text and pick out your shop's details.
To apply fair usage limits and fix problems.

sections.title: What is public
sections.body: Once you publish a shop, its name, description, products, prices, photos, address, hours and contact numbers are visible to anyone with the link. Draft shops are private. You can take your shop offline at any time.

sections.title: Who we share information with
sections.body: We don't sell your information and we don't show advertising. We share only what's needed with the services that run VoiceCart:
points: Google Gemini: picks out shop details from your text.
Our hosting provider: runs the website.

sections.title: Where information is stored
sections.body: Our database is hosted in India. Some of the services above may process information in other countries, under their own privacy terms.

sections.title: How long we keep information
sections.body: We keep your account and shop information while your account is open, and the text of your setup answers for as long as your shop needs it. When you ask us to delete your account, we remove your information from our active systems, except where we must keep it by law. Copies held in backups or by service providers can take some time to clear.

sections.title: Your choices
points: Correct your shop's details and products in your dashboard at any time.
Take your shop offline at any time.
Ask us for a copy of your information.
Ask us to delete your account and information. Deleting from inside the app isn't available yet, so please contact us.

sections.title: Security
sections.body: Access to your shop's information is limited to your account, and connections are encrypted. Secret keys stay on our servers. No online service can be completely secure, so please keep your Google account safe.

sections.title: Children
sections.body: VoiceCart is meant for shop owners who are adults. We don't knowingly collect information from children.

sections.title: Changes to this policy
sections.body: If we change this policy, we'll update the date at the top of this page. For important changes, we'll also let shop owners know.

consent.title: Before you continue
consent.body: Please read how VoiceCart looks after your information. You only need to do this once.
consent.note: By continuing, you agree to this Privacy Policy.
